notes.title: Discount in support of hospitals and caregivers
notes.notes:
Microids commits to give 10% of the profits to the Hospitals of Paris - Hospitals of France foundation to join the effort in these times of crisis. 

Together let's support these everyday heroes!

notes.title: Toki is back!
notes.notes:
Toki will be available on June 6th on Steam!

(Re)discover the 2D action and platform game with new features:
🙉 A speedrun mode
🙊 5 graphic filters
🙈 A jukebox including 32 music tracks
